pages.text: Hold the catalog and sneak-right-click a chest or another supported inventory to register that location. Repeat to remove it. Right-click in the air to open the catalog. Nearby tracked storage is marked while you hold it.
Rename a catalog to tell different stockrooms apart.

pages.title: Find a Stack
pages.text: Sort the summary by name or quantity, then select an item to see its counts and locations. Double chest halves are counted separately. Locked or unloaded containers may be unavailable.

pages.title: Follow a Location
pages.text: Select one of the waypoint compasses you are carrying and assign it to a container location from the catalog. Follow it in the recorded dimension. The catalog can read compatible modded storage through its exposed inventory.
